name: Player
definition: An individual footballer. Each player appears once in the roster table; time-varying ability ratings live in a separate snapshot table.
scope: Player identity, naming and physical measurements across all leagues and seasons.

name: Player Name
definition: The player's full display name, held in one text column. There is no separate first-name or last-name field.
scope: Name-based lookup and filtering of players.

name: Player Birthdate
definition: Player date of birth, stored as a text timestamp, used for age and born-before/born-after-year filters.

name: Player Height
definition: Player height in centimetres.

name: Player Attribute Snapshot
definition: A dated snapshot of one player's ability ratings. The same player has many snapshots over time, so the table is a history, not one row per player.
scope: Questions about a player's abilities at a point in time or averaged over a period.

name: Overall Rating
definition: The player's overall ability score in a snapshot; a bounded numeric rating where higher is better.
scope: Rating comparisons, averages and point-in-time lookups.

name: Finishing
definition: The player's finishing ability score in a snapshot.

name: Volley
definition: The player's volley ability score in a snapshot.

name: Dribbling
definition: The player's dribbling ability score in a snapshot.

name: Attacking Work Rate
definition: Categorical rating of how often a player joins the attack when the team attacks.

name: Defensive Work Rate
definition: Categorical rating of how often a player holds position and defends while the team attacks.

name: Team
definition: A football club. Each team appears once in the team table with two alternative identifier systems.

name: Team Long Name
definition: The club's full display name.

name: Team Short Name
definition: The club's abbreviated three-letter code.
scope: Compact team identification; not unique across teams.

name: Team Attribute Snapshot
definition: A dated snapshot of one team's playing-style attributes covering build-up play, chance creation and defence. A team has up to six snapshots.
scope: Team style questions, including year-qualified ones.

name: Build-up Play Speed
definition: Numeric speed of a team's build-up play on a 0-100 style scale (observed 20-80), paired with a Balanced/Fast/Slow class.

name: Build-up Play Passing
definition: Numeric quality and length tendency of a team's build-up passing (observed 20-80), paired with a Mixed/Short/Long class.
scope: Team passing-style comparisons and above-average filtering.

name: Chance Creation Passing
definition: Numeric propensity of a team to create chances through passing (observed 21-80), paired with a Safe/Normal/Risky class.

name: Chance Creation Passing Style
definition: Categorical bucket of a team's chance-creation passing: Safe, Normal or Risky.
scope: Questions about playing safe or risky when creating chances.

name: League
definition: A domestic league competition, named and linked to its country.

name: Country
definition: The country a league belongs to.
scope: Country attribution of leagues and matches.

name: Season
definition: The competition season label, written as two consecutive years (for example 2015/2016), naming the year the season started.

name: Match
definition: A single league fixture between a home and an away team, carrying goals, season, stage and competition context.

name: Home Team
definition: The team playing at home in a match.

name: Away Team
definition: The team playing away in a match.

name: Home Goals
definition: Goals scored by the home team in a match.

name: Away Goals
definition: Goals scored by the away team in a match.

name: Total Goals
definition: Total goals scored in a match, derived from the home and away goal counts.
scope: Goal-total aggregation at match, team, league or season level.

name: Match Result
definition: The outcome of a match - home win, draw or away win - determined by comparing the two goal totals.

name: Team FIFA API Identifier
definition: The team's FIFA-API identifier; match rows and team-attribute rows use it to reference a team.
scope: Team identity when joining matches or team attributes, and when an identifier is explicitly requested.

name: Team API Identifier
definition: An alternative team identifier held only in the team table; it uses a different, disjoint value space from the FIFA-API identifier and is null for eleven teams.
scope: Team identity only when explicitly requested; not used by match or team-attribute rows.
